Name: Sebastian Dialogue for The Stardew Squad
Author: elee7420
Description:
[size=5][b]Sebastian Dialogue for The Stardew Squad

[/b][/size][size=4]✨ [b]About This Mod[/b]

[/size]This mod adds [b]300+ lines of original dialogue[/b] for Sebastian, written for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url].It is a faithful character expansion that builds on Sebastian's established canon personality while staying true to the beloved character development of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25841]Maggs Immersive Sebastian[/url].The dialogue reveals an awkward, geeky, and deeply loyal companion who slowly learns to open up—capturing his struggles with family, passion for technology and music, and the subtle warmth he shows only to those he trusts.

[line][size=4]✨ [b]What This Mod Does[/b]

[/size][list][*]Adds 300+ lines of original, context-aware Sebastian dialogue
[*]Expands emotional depth while remaining fully in-character
[*]Integrates seamlessly with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url] companion system
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25841]Maggs Immersive Sebastian[/url]
[*]Features location-specific dialogue for farm, mines, town, volcano, and more
[/list][line][size=4]
💬 [b]Character Development[/b]

[/size]Based on the completed dialogue in the mod file, Sebastian's character arc progresses through three distinct stages:

[b]Low Hearts (Acquaintance)[/b]  
Reserved, socially awkward, and self-deprecating. He's hesitant to connect and socially awkward. His humor is dry and he often feels out of place in social or outdoor settings.

[b]High Hearts (Close Friend / Romantic)[/b]  
More open and vulnerable. He shares personal thoughts about his family, shows concern for the player's safety and reveals romantic interest with awkward sincerity. His protective instincts emerge, though he remains self-aware of his limitations.

[b]Spouse[/b]  
Still fundamentally Sebastian—awkward, dryly humorous, and chronically indoorsy—but now with someone who understands him. He's a devoted partner who expresses love through practical actions and deadpan humor rather than grand gestures. Married life hasn't changed his core personality, just given it a home. He's protective in his own way, affectionate with a side of self-awareness, and committed despite his perpetual state of mild discomfort with the outdoors, farm chores, and social expectations.

[line]

[size=4]📜 [b]Dialogue Features[/b]

[/size]The mod includes comprehensive dialogue for various activities and locations:
• Location-specific lines for farm, mines, town, house, volcano, beach, Secret Woods, and winter settings
• Activity dialogue for attacking, lumbering, mining, watering, harvesting, foraging, fishing, and petting animals
• Weather and seasonal dialogue (rain, winter)
• Relationship-specific recruit and dismiss dialogue for each heart level
• Idle conversation lines that reveal his evolving personality
[line][size=4]
🔧[b]Compatibility & Notes
[/b]
[/size][list]
[size=4][/size][list][*]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url] by ThaliaFawnheart
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25841]Maggs Immersive Sebastian[/url] or any other canon-friendly Sebastian expansion mod 
[*]Safe to add to or remove from existing saves
[/list][/list][line][size=4]
🛠 [b]Future Plans

[/b][/size]Future character packs are planned for:
• Sam • Elliott • Shane• Abigail• Emily• Penny

[size=4]🌏 [b]Localization Plans[/b]

[/size]Chinese translation is planned for all dialogue packs listed above.

[line]

[size=4]💙 [b]Special Thanks[/b]

[/size]A huge thank you to [b]ThaliaFawnheart[/b], creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url], for making this mod possible.

Special thanks to [b]MaggPlays[/b] for creating the incredible [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25841]Maggs Immersive Sebastian[/url]. This dialogue expansion builds upon your exceptional character work and voice for Sebastian.

[line]

This project began as a personal passion to give Sebastian more presence in the world, especially when traveling alongside the farmer. I wanted to capture his dry humor, social anxiety, slow-burn warmth, and unexpected domestic side as he finds a home he didn't know he wanted.

Enjoy your time with Sebastian.  
Even the quietest voices have the most to say.
